title: Rabbi Bran was struck and paralyzed
summary: In 1920, Rabbi Shmuel Shlomo Bran was struck in the head during the Halertschiks' attack and became paralyzed.
uncertaintyNote: The event type is limited by the schema; the text describes an assault, not a fire.
